components.name: Royal directional sign frame
components.function: Missing local reusable sign hosts; printed names on sheet outside objects only
components.construction: One human-size royal directional sign frame, readable blank inset face for later actual location labels; source gold/ivory for royal signs, cedar for forests, sea brass for port.
